Influenza vaccination coverage was 81.0% among HCP at acute care hospitals and 47.1% among those working at nursing homes.
Among HCP working in acute care hospitals, influenza vaccination coverage was highest in the Midwest (84.7%) and lowest in the Pacific region (74.4%).
Coverage with each vaccine was calculated for HCP working at each facility type (nursing home or acute care hospital).
Results were further stratified by employment category (employee, licensed practitioner, and student or volunteer)
Health care facilities report vaccination of HCP against influenza and COVID-19 to CDC’s National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN).
